params.query:
SELECT e.id,
       e.workflow_name AS workflow,
       e.run_mode AS mode,
       TO_CHAR(e.started_at, 'HH24:MI') AS at,
       COALESCE(s.step ->> 'nodeId', '-') AS node,
       COALESCE(LEFT(s.step ->> 'error', 200), 'unknown error') AS error,
       :baseUrl || '/executions/' || e.id AS url
FROM executions e
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT step
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.steps_json::jsonb) AS step
    WHERE step ->> 'error' IS NOT NULL
    LIMIT 1
) s ON true
WHERE e.status = 'ERROR'
  AND e.started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
ORDER BY e.started_at DESC

params.text: 🔴 {{ errors.count }} failed execution(s) in the last 10 minutes
